description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity that demonstrates the use of a TextSwitcher widget with fade in/out animations and a button to increment a counter displayed by the TextSwitcher.

classes.name: TextSwitcher1
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating the use of a TextSwitcher with animated transitions and a button to update the displayed counter.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the layout, TextSwitcher, animations, and button listener.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles button clicks to increment the counter and update the display.

methods.name: updateCounter
methods.description: Updates the TextSwitcher with the current counter value.

methods.name: makeView
methods.description: Creates and returns a new TextView configured as the displayed view in the TextSwitcher.
